# `jouet wait daemon`

- **Usage:** `jouet wait daemon [FLAGS] <ID>`

Wait for a pitchfork daemon to be ready, or to stop

For a project's long-running services, the daemons pitchfork runs (one-off work is `wait job`'s). Reads `pitchfork status ID --json` in this directory, so a short ID resolves in this project's namespace. Ready is `running` and, when there is a port to try (--port, or the port pitchfork says the daemon binds) or a URL (--http), answering there: pitchfork's JSON does not say whether its own ready check passed. --until stopped waits until the daemon no longer runs. A daemon that errors or fails ends the wait with exit 1; then, and on a timeout, the end of its log is shown and the whole log is saved. Exits 3 when pitchfork has no such daemon and 4 when pitchfork is not installed.

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The daemon's ID: `api`, or `namespace/api`

## Flags
- **`--until <CONDITION>`** — `ready` (the default) or `stopped`
- **`--port <N>`** — Ready once localhost's port N accepts connections
- **`--http <URL>`** — Ready once URL answers with a 2xx status
- **`--log-lines <N>`** — Lines of its log to show on failure or timeout (default 60; 0 shows all of it)
- **`--no-logs`** — Do not read its log
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
